coverage: Distinct source and destination synthetic facts in unique production SQLCipher/Room stores and Keystore aliases.
Count actual logical-record callbacks, inject a distinct CancellationException at each, require exact exception identity and callback number.
Compare every persisted application table, including FactOrigin and StoreMetadata, immediately and after close/reopen at every cancellation.
Pre-outer-commit injected IOException rolls back a fully applied replacement, immediately and after reopen.
Post-commit injected observer IOException leaves imported rows durable after reopen and destination metadata unchanged.
Repeated low-level replacement yields identical persisted rows/provenance; source and validated staging remain unchanged.

implementation.sourceHashScope: sourceSha256 records working-tree bytes used by the build; repositoryLfSourceSha256 records Git LF-normalized bytes.

limits: Logical-record callback coverage only; not every instruction, coroutine suspension or durable-storage boundary.
Injected cancellation and IOException, not OS process kill, power loss, disk-full/ENOSPC or crash durability.
Low-level store replacement, not coordinator command replay, concurrent ingestion, owner/UI success reporting or consent-disable integration.
No provider transport, Android-managed fresh-install recovery, actual callback overlap, maximum logical history or resource qualification.
No new production behavior, capability promotion, release clearance or auto-scroll/playback progress qualification; seven-day baseline unstarted; emulator deferred.
next: Advance isolated process-interruption/low-space/owner recovery, protection/lifecycle and core accessibility gates without replacing real history. Source acquisition still needs a new source-qualified hypothesis; do not repeat unchanged cache/time/vision negatives.
